people.name: Ephron
people.line: A Hittite who sold a burial site to Abraham.

people.name: Machpelah
people.line: A cave near Hebron; burial place of patriarchs

people.name: Mamre
people.line: A place near Hebron; associated with Abraham

translations.web: So the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, the cave which was in it, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all of its borders, were deeded
translations.bsb: So Ephron’s field at Machpelah near Mamre, the cave that was in it, and all the trees within the boundaries of the field were deeded over
translations.kjv: And the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, and the cave which was therein, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all the borders round about, were made sure
translations.asv: So the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, and the cave which was therein, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all the border thereof round about, were made sure
